Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: NYC venue late-booking surcharge — request for one-time approval

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Quick heads-up on the Acme Enterprise Workshop (May 18-19, NYC). Vendor confirmed the venue but we were outside the 60-day rate window; BrightEvents is asking for a $9,250 late-booking surcharge to guarantee the ballroom and AV package. Attached is the quote and the draft SOW from BrightEvents for reference.

Why we need the exception: Acme's timelines slipped (sales-requested date) and they will only commit to these two dates. This workshop is tied to the ACME expansion pilot (deal ACM-7892) — losing the proposed dates would likely push the kickoff by a month, which is risky for the commitment timeline.

Requesting:
- One-time approval for the $9,250 surcharge (to be charged to a one-time exceptions cost center)
- If approved, Laura please provide a charge code and GL for procurement.
- Marissa / Evelyn: confirm whether we should ask Acme to split the surcharge (they previously agreed to 25% client contribution in principle).

Attachments: venue_quote_NYC_04127.pdf (quote), BrightEvents_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW)

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NYC venue late-booking surcharge — request for one-time approval

Thanks Ben —

Quick notes after skimming the quote: the $9,250 is primarily the rate premium plus an expedited AV mobilization fee ($1,200). Helpful to see a 2-line breakdown: venue premium and AV/tech rush.

I think we can ask Acme to cover 25% ($2,312) given this is a schedule-driven ask, and Redwood covers the remainder. If Acme refuses, we should at least try a 50/50 split.

Two asks for internal approvals:
1) Evelyn — can you confirm whether Customer Success is comfortable asking Acme for a partial contribution? We don't want to jeopardize the relationship.
2) Laura — if you approve an exceptions charge, can you also confirm the maximum allowable amount on a single PO without exec sign-off? If it requires exec, we'll route differently.

Also — small ask: can we get the vendor to remove the 1-day hold fee if we finalize within 48 hours? Ben, can you push on that with Jessica at BrightEvents?
